conflicts: Cableway: c23/c24 present the Taiqing cableway as a normal option (separate ticket, half price for seniors). The official notice (2026-04-18) says it has been suspended since 2026-04-24, and the 2026-08-31 notice says safety rectification is ongoing. The guide should say it is currently suspended.

Hualou: the 2025-12-29 reservation flow (c35/c36) calls booking '免费预约'. Since 2026-04-01 Hualou costs 10元 (2026-03-27 notice; fee table 2026-06-04). The booking flow is probably still valid but no longer free.

Hours: no official page gives the normal opening hours of the south and east lines (太清/巨峰/仰口/华严). The only hours found (c33) come from a single-day 2025-10-23 adjustment notice. Keep hours unconfirmed. Lookups tried: home notices and guide centre.
Stale source: News-info-nid-5571 (游览须知) is dated 2024-09-17, over 12 months old. c39 and c49 now state the date.
The official Korean page (New-Korean-index.html) describes 9 scenic areas. The current Chinese page lists 7 (c7). The Korean page is outdated; follow the Chinese page.
Record address (梅岭路29号) is the site footer address, not a visitor entrance. For travellers, give the 大河东/仰口/九水 visitor centres instead.

Not useful for travellers: c28–c32 (military, veterans, fire-rescue, press, tour guides) are administrative discount groups. Collapse them to seniors 60+, children ≤6 or ≤1.4m, students/minors half price. Whether passports count as 有效证件 is not stated.

notes: All 26 cited URLs were opened with curl; HTML comments, scripts and styles were stripped before judging.
The Laoshan fee table (News-info-nid-6407, an image dated 2026-06-04) was downloaded and read directly. All fee figures in c10–c20, plus c22, c23 and c50, match the image.
Biggest traveller-impact issue: the Taiqing cableway has been suspended since 2026-04-24 per an official notice. Claims c23/c24 do not mention it; add the suggested claim.
Hualou reservation flow (2025-12) describes free booking. It has cost 10元 since 2026-04-01.
Opening hours are unconfirmed for all three places; no official hours page was found.
Long administrative discount-group lists (wtown c22–c24, c27–c28; Laoshan c28–c32) are verified but have little value for travellers. Recommend collapsing them.
Undated official FAQ pages (wtown question.html, Laoshan Zixun-qinfo) carry current fee and parking rules; show the checked date.
